scientific_integrity: Proof and exact finite reproductions are distinguished. The new results are the full gap histogram, four support regimes and general affine gap-spectrum law; previously known maximal-gap multiplicities are credited.
scientific_limitations: The full length-frequency table is specialized to the cofactor 15; the general theorem gives an algorithmic cyclic formula for any odd squarefree cofactor.
Coefficient block descriptions in older work could provide an implicit route to the present affine law and are an originality risk.
The embedded finite checker validates table arithmetic, not the universal theorem; the latter has a self-contained proof.
Independent mathematical evaluation has not been performed.
title: Exact affine gap spectra for cyclotomic prime extensions, including every \(\Phi_{15p}\)
